execution_requirements.replay_command: acquire the NIST WebBook fluid endpoint listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/engineering/coverage_work_orders/oc133_engineering_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check

fail_closed_reason: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: hidden transport properties appear in visible rows before prediction materialization; NIST WebBook source snapshot hash is missing or changes; constant room-temperature comparator ties or beats the interpolation model; fewer than 20 hidden property targets are scored

incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: Predict every hidden row using the visible row closest to 298.15 K for that property.
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: Implement a domain-specific scorer when this generic pack remains fail-closed.
no_fake_closure_policy: This pack is source-bound but cannot promote broad superiority unless actual target-hidden scoring materially beats the preregistered comparator.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: Acquire target-hidden source data, materialize OC and incumbent predictions, compute residuals, then rerun this pack and replay.

replay.replay_command: acquire the NIST WebBook fluid endpoint listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/engineering/coverage_work_orders/oc133_engineering_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check
replay_commands: acquire the NIST WebBook fluid endpoint listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/engineering/coverage_work_orders/oc133_engineering_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check

residual_requirement.formula: relative absolute residual per hidden property; aggregate mean relative absolute error
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: interpolator aggregate residual plus uncertainty allowance must be lower than the room-temperature constant comparator

residuals.material_margin_rule: interpolator aggregate residual plus uncertainty allowance must be lower than the room-temperature constant comparator

source.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source.source_name: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD 69 thermophysical fluid-property table for water

target_variable.name: water_thermal_transport_properties_at_one_atmosphere
target_variable.unit: density mol/l, viscosity uPa*s, thermal conductivity W/m*K

uncertainty_requirement.metric: relative absolute residual per hidden property; aggregate mean relative absolute error
uncertainty_requirement.rule: fixed table precision plus visible-row interpolation residual envelope

why_it_failed: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.
